claim: The House of Dancing Water reopened in 2025 after a five-year hiatus as a reimagined production directed by Giuliano Peparini, with an 80-minute runtime, five days a week, shows at 5pm/8pm (Nov-May) and 4:30pm/7:30pm (Jun-Oct).
quote: The reimagined show returned in 2025 after a five-year hiatus. Director Giuliano Peparini ... The 80-minute performance runs five days weekly with shows at: 5pm & 8pm (November-May) 4:30pm & 7:30pm (June-October)

claim: House of Dancing Water 2026 seat tiers run Gallery from $87, Signature $111, Grand $136, Premium $152, Golden Circle $187, and VVIP Box $3,500-$4,700, on a stage holding water equal to five Olympic pools.
quote: Gallery: from $87 ... Golden Circle: from $187 VVIP Box: $3,500-$4,700 ... The stage holds water equivalent to five Olympic-sized pools and showcases high dives, aerial stunts

claim: The House of Magic at Studio City Macau (Franz Harary's multi-theater illusion show) is now permanently closed.
quote: This location was reported permanently closed.

claim: Macau's top high-floor bars include the Ritz-Carlton Bar & Lounge on the 51st floor of Galaxy Macau with panoramic Cotai views, Sky 21 on the 21st floor of AIA Tower, and 38 Lounge on the 38th floor of Altira Hotel with skyline views and live music.
quote: The Ritz-Carlton Bar & Lounge - Location: 51st floor ... panoramic Cotai views ... Sky 21 ... 21st floor, AIA Tower ... 38 Lounge ... 38th floor, Altira Hotel ... skyline views

claim: Macau nightlife centers on the Cotai Strip (casinos and clubs), Macau Peninsula (local bars, historic streets), and Taipa Village (relaxed pubs and rooftop bars); Club Cubic at City of Dreams hosts DJs like David Guetta and Tiesto, and Pacha Macau at Studio City is an open-air Ibiza-style club.
quote: Cotai Strip serves as the heart of Macau nightlife ... Club Cubic, located at City of Dreams ... hosts world-famous DJs like David Guetta and Tiesto ... Pacha Macau at Studio City offers an open-air club with a beach party feel

claim: Macau Tower hosts the world's highest commercial bungee jump (233m, AJ Hackett) plus a handrail-free Skywalk on the outer rim, an evening adventure option for nightlife-adjacent thrill seekers.
quote: world's highest commercial bungee jump, operated by AJ Hackett, where you can jump from a platform at 233 meters ... The skywalk at 233 meters allows you to walk around the outer rim ... Night Bungy jumping is available
